fields.label: Source Label
fields.help: Stored as the message's source, e.g. outlook, gmail

fields.label: Direction
fields.help: inbound: sync each message's sender as the person (use with an inbox read). outbound: sync each recipient as the person instead (use with a sentitems/sent-mail read).

fields.label: Profile ID
fields.help: Which profile owns the synced people/messages. Defaults to 'default' — set this explicitly if this workflow belongs to a different profile (find the ID via `monoagentcli profile list`).
